objective: Complete priorities 1 through 6 and verify quality against the product's author-facing goals.

requirements.name: Editorial judgment and Writing Voice
requirements.acceptance: Focused, evidence-backed chapter review and revisions improve the author's decisions while preserving established facts, knowledge, voice and deliberate ambiguity. Evaluate omissions, false alarms, inventions and retained/rejected edits on fresh connected prose.
implemented: Focused passage and Plan-chapter critique
Exact quote/offset validation with unsupported findings withheld
Visible uncertainty, strengths, review limits and minimal intervention
Approved Writing Voice guidance included in selection and chapter preparation with stale-context checks
Read-only critique cannot be applied as a prose mutation
Unique exact source quotation can recover inaccurate provider offsets, with disclosed correction and unchanged raw feedback
Fresh Writing Voice analysis aligns captured exemplar/source versions so approved learned guidance reaches revision context
Malformed supplied Writing Voice source-version maps are rejected before saving; legacy malformed metadata stays unverified
Optional authored fact/knowledge/uncertainty/protected-text/end-beat constraints retained exactly with source-bound fingerprints and immutable preview receipts across refinement/staging

Retained preservation drafts and profile/refinement recovery remain book/Storyline/version scoped during late completions

Approved connected refinement after preservation-input repair and author assessment; existing live alternatives remain unchanged and require revision. Replay verifies mechanics, not improved live prose.

requirements.acceptance: Authors can inspect exact evidence, correct person/place classification, triage efficiently, retain unfinished corrections and reject stale decisions. Measure missing and unwanted suggestions on fresh material and observe review burden.
implemented: Grammar-aware suppression of temporal/clausal openers and restrictive modifiers
Correctable entity types retained across rescans
Source-, suggestion- and Storyline-scoped review versions
Main-editor Memory suggestion inbox with exact evidence, retained corrections and explicit refreshed review
Entity-type correction refuses an incompatible existing identity before alias mutation
Typed Memory values validate before new writes while unchanged legacy values remain readable and retained
Explicit scanning limits describe uncased names and person/place review

Direct accepted-fact correction drafts recover by book, Storyline and fact while preserving the loaded version and newer edits during delayed saves

remaining: Observe author review time, omissions and unwanted suggestions on fresh original prose

requirements.name: Daily writing and review polish

Selection actions outside scrolling context
Arrow/Home/End continuity navigation

requirements.name: Actual mobile companion delivery
requirements.acceptance: A published book opens on physical iPhone and Android; scene-aware voice survives interruption/reconnect; encrypted captured ideas return to desktop review. Unfinished capture and reading location survive cold restart without plaintext storage.
implemented: Device-encrypted companion recovery
Cold/offline restart and idempotent capture retry
Cross-window sign-out redaction
Atomic encrypted SQLite snapshot/auth/recovery storage, verified legacy migration
Conditional migration and auth lease fences preserve refreshed data and prevent in-flight SDK refresh from restoring signed-out credentials
Production gateway issuance quotas are database-owned and atomic across devices/books/replicas, rechecking queued device/project authority before consumption
Ambiguous encrypted snapshot publication outcomes retain ciphertext, acknowledge only exact committed metadata, and never automatically delete or retry publication

Current live Auth-session, workspace membership and active-project checks protect ongoing Realtime authority, device registration/token claims, encrypted-sync RPCs and Storage policies; server-owned publishing key state separates active keys from historical envelopes

Server-owned renewable voice leases retain immutable hard deadlines, autonomously poll authority, journal known upstream calls before answer delivery, block issuance during uncertain cleanup and stop retired client media/context; local HTTP/SIGKILL and hosted App controls pass

Desktop trusted-device review supports deliberate per-book revocation, exact-recipient/version rotation, explicit publication, scoped draft/late-outcome recovery and account-reset redaction; wrong-book recovery keys cannot replace the verified current key

Desktop missing-envelope recovery authenticates the current committed manifest and exact snapshot, then installs only its own exact current-device/version sealed envelope; lost replies receive positive-only exact readback and session/account races remain fenced

Permanent project namespace tombstones, privileged upload-completion fences and leased orphan-inclusive Storage cleanup preserve pending intent across crash/lost replies; a separate verifier role is required for attested metadata finalization

Reviewed multi-project account deletion freezes current authority, captures exact per-project/workspace dispositions, visibly acknowledges retained shared history, composes attested project cleanup and blocks Auth removal while voice cleanup remains unresolved.

Desktop reviewed account inventory lists current devices and prior deletion jobs, preserves same-session refocus, blocks concurrent cloud actions during a lost reply and supports account-only device enrollment without publishing a book.

Independent known-call control persists scope, credential binding and immutable deadlines before answering; scoped renewal and durable restart recovery close known calls after gateway loss while the controller and provider control path remain available.
Workspace bootstrap preserves existing roles and refuses cross-author legacy takeover; registry RLS checks live unfrozen current membership without recursive workspace-member policies.
remaining: Physical iPhone and Android reading, audio permissions/routing, interruption/reconnect, encrypted capture handoff and cold restart.

Apply and drill the reviewed migrations and separate worker/controller credentials in the approved deployment; verify authorization, revocation, rotation and deletion against actual Storage backing versions, in-flight uploads and failed-upload queues before finalization.
Real-device encrypted key and credential migration acceptance, including current-source native account management and signed Keychain behavior.
A retained shared project moved or deleted after account review can block the immutable intent; a reviewed amendment or operator reconciliation workflow remains open.
Reconcile provider allocation before a durable call ID. Strict expiry during complete controller/state/provider-control-network outages and final media/billing cleanup remain unestablished.

Missing-envelope recovery requires a current committed snapshot or independently verified current key. No-current-snapshot recovery stays refused; a reviewed new rotation or future project-bound commitment remains required.

requirements.name: Packaged-app recovery
requirements.acceptance: Forced termination during saves, multi-scene apply/undo and restores recovers a coherent book. Unknown newer writing is retained and requires explicit reviewed resolution. Native restart and backup restoration preserve exact prose and history.
implemented: Durable write-ahead book transactions

Empty parts/chapters and outline-only books survive export, preview and import without phantom scenes
remaining: Full signed/clean-machine multi-scene GUI recovery and upgrade acceptance
Physical power-loss and noncooperating-writer limitations remain explicit
